title: The First Page
summary: Sister Ilse, a Grey Sister at the Shrine of the Ember in Thornwick, is writing down whatever the old empire left in the barrows: the Chronicle. So far nothing has come out of them but the dead, and they don't hold still to be read.

steps.journal: Find a Chronicle fragment in the Old Barrows: anything with the old imperial stamp on it. The chests on the first floor are a start.

objectives.label: Fragments found in the Old Barrows

ready: Take it to Sister Ilse, on the step of the Shrine of the Ember in Thornwick.
done: You brought Sister Ilse the first fragment out of the barrows. The Chronicle of the Vale has a first page.
